description: This file defines a PHP class 'FormatWithWorkStation' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. Its purpose is to format a given entity value by retrieving the associated Subunit's name using a service. The class resides within the 'OrangeHRM\' namespace hierarchy and leverages traits for service access.

classes.name: FormatWithWorkStation
classes.description: A class that formats a value by retrieving and returning the corresponding Subunit's name if available.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the Subunit corresponding to the provided entity value, or null if not found.
